Device.title: Device
Device.description: An Android device reporting its Bluetooth connection status and active sub-devices.

bluetoothPoweredOn.description: Whether the Android Bluetooth adapter itself is active

connectedDevices.description: List of connected accessory Bluetooth devices

/users/{uid}/devices/{deviceId}/commands.description: A collection of asynchronous command executions targeted to devices.
